english.title: Controller / manager / landlord etc of residential accommodation required to be licensed under Part 3 of the Act
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 95(1)(a), (1A) and (5) of the Housing Act 2004.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
having control of / managing a house OR
being a landlord or licensor in relation to a person occupying the house under a tenancy or licence
the house being required to be licensed under Pt 3 of the Housing Act 2004
but was not so licensed

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) In proceedings against a person for an offence under section 95(1)(a), it is a defence for the person prove that they had a reasonable excuse -
for having control of or managing the house, or for being the landlord or licensor in relation to a person occupying the house under a tenancy or licence, in circumstances in which the house was required to be licensed under this Part but was not so licensed.
(ii) For an offence committed before the 1st May 2026, see H15310.
(iii) For offences where a landlord or licensor has a superior interest in the house, see H102711.
